title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta33

## Control state reliability
- Resolve a paused vendor task using fresh MQTT named `isPaused` evidence and retained task context, instead of trusting only a possibly lagging private-cloud `0211` status. MQTT numeric state `3` alone is ambiguous (paused/idle), and fresh mowing state `4` wins over old cloud pause.
- Propagate fresh named MQTT state through the normalized snapshot, settling local optimistic mowing activity when a confirmed Pause arrives.
- Route HA `lawn_mower.start_mowing` on paused tasks to vendor Resume rather than starting a new reset cycle. Prevent duplicate start requests while actively mowing or returning.
- Reject stale persisted `last_ordered_run` continuation when the vendor's current zone cycle or active session started later. The matching zone list alone is not proof of task identity.
- Keep manual `navimower.mow(reset=true)` as the explicit new-cycle operation. An interrupted task with `reset=false` and a different zone remains blocked.
- Regression tests verify the Nov 14 H215 command race, ambiguous MQTT state `3`, and retained old run after a new task.

### Testing
The earlier H215 physical Pause/Resume/Dock round trip was confirmed in `beta32`. This version still needs on-device regression testing and must not be promoted to stable until verified.

### Companion card
Use `navimower-map-card 0.4.0-beta8` for four always-visible buttons (Resume, Mow, Pause, Dock) whose disabled state matches the mower state.
